title: Roleplay, Music & Status Rotation
summary: The roleplay cog was completely rewritten to use nekos.best API GIFs with CV2 layout messages and a persistent 'hug back' button. The music cog was restructured with a ghost queue feature and fixed autoplay/Spotify playback. A status message rotation system was added with a configurable timer.

highlights.title: Roleplay Rewrite
highlights.description: The roleplay cog now fetches SFW reaction GIFs from nekos.best, renders them in styled CV2 containers, and includes a 'hug back' button that persists across restarts. A single user context menu replaces individual action menus to stay under Discord's 15-command cap.

highlights.title: Music Ghost Queue
highlights.description: A new ghost queue feature lets songs be queued even when nothing is currently playing. Autoplay and Spotify playback were also fixed.

highlights.title: Status Rotation
highlights.description: The bot now rotates through configurable status messages on a timer (default 30s interval), with activity types and a VR device presence.
